🚦 CYBERABAD TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚴‍♀️

🎗️A Cancer Awareness Women’s Bike Ride will be conducted in the Madhapur – Raidurgam – Gachibowli – Narsingi stretches from 06:00 AM to 09:00 AM on (01.02.2026)

A large number of cyclists will be participating in this awareness initiative. 
Motorists may experience slow traffic movement along parts of the route during the event.

Advisory to Road Users:
• Drive cautiously and stay alert near cyclists 
• Maintain safe distance and avoid sudden overtaking 
• Follow on-ground diversions and traffic police instructions 
• Plan your travel in advance 

⏳Let us support the cause while ensuring safety for everyone on the road.

Early detection saves lives. Road safety saves lives too. 

#TrafficAdvisory #CancerAwareness
#WomenRideSafe #RoadSafety
#CyberabadTrafficPolice
